title: Automated quality checkpoints for model version pins and catalog propagation
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Implement an automated eval orchestration that runs targeted quality checks whenever a model version is pinned or when catalog metadata for a model changes. This covers both Redwood catalog model promotions and customer-pinned model updates. The feature must provide fast, deterministic pass/fail signals and integrate with Console rollouts and the model pin lifecycle so we can gate upgrades or auto-rollback on regressions.
acceptance_criteria:
1) When a catalog model version is pinned, the eval orchestration kicks off a configurable suite (smoke + regression + safety) and reports a clear result within configured SLO (default: 15 minutes).
2) For customer-pinned models, a lightweight eval run (subset of test prompts + embeddings checks) executes automatically and surfaces a pass/fail with a breakdown in the Console.
3) Failed evaluations block automatic pin promotions and create a rollback ticket + alert to the owning teams.
4) Console shows per-pin evaluation summary, diffs vs baseline, and links to failing examples.
5) Metrics emitted to telemetry: eval_duration_seconds, eval_pass_rate, top_regression_types.
6) Feature toggle and dry-run mode available for initial rollout.
7) End-to-end e2e tests and infra load tests included in PR.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (alpha): internal tenants + canary orgs. Dry-run mode on by default for first 2 weeks to gather signal without blocking.
Phase 2 (beta): enable hard-gating for selected catalog pipelines and a subset of customer orgs with manual opt-in.
Phase 3 (GA): default gating for catalog promotions; customer-pinned gating is opt-out.
Rollback: automatic unpin + alert OR revert to previous pinned version if critical regressions detected.
Communication: product release notes, Console banner, and a short how-to doc for SE/CS teams.
monitoring_metrics:
- eval_run.count
- eval_run.duration_seconds
- eval_result.pass_rate
- eval_failure.top_reasons (list)
- pin_promotion.blocked_count
- customer_alerts_sent
ui_changes:
- Add 'Evaluation' tab to Pin detail view showing latest runs, pass/fail, sample failures, and links to full eval run.
- Global Console widget showing pending blocked promotions and recent regressions.
- Toggle in project/settings to opt into hard gating or dry-run for customer pins.
infra_changes:
- Small orchestration service (eval-orch) that accepts pin events and launches eval jobs.
- Job queue and priority lanes for fast smoke evals vs full regression suites.
- Storage for eval artifacts (examples, outputs, diffs) with TTL.
- Integration hooks to rollout system for canary gating and auto-rollback.
- Telemetry producers for metrics above.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for orchestration logic and hook handlers.
- Integration tests: pin a test model -> ensure eval job launched -> simulated pass/fail -> verify gating behavior.
- Load test: simulate 200 concurrent pin events and ensure eval-orch scales and does not overrun infra.
- Evals correctness: run smoke, regression, and safety suites against known baselines to validate deterministic outputs.
